blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. welcomed Southeast Asian leaders and dignitaries at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) on Sunday ahead of the opening ceremony of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits.
